title: Zesty Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A pungent and tender Tunisian dish featuring lamb and meringue nests, cooked in a donabe vessel with shio-cure and paleo-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the donabe vessel to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with shio cure and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in the donabe and sear the lamb shoulder until browned.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the donabe and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, coriander, and lemon juice to the donabe and stir to combine.
Cover the donabe and cook for 2 hours or until the lamb is tender.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the meringue nests according to package instructions.
To serve, place a portion of the lamb on a plate and top with a meringue nest.
